title: When resistance keeps arguing with Hukam as a steady practice
issueStatement: The mind wants reality to arrive on self-approved terms. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru reframes peace as understanding the command already holding everything. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Peace begins when the mind stops arguing with what already stands inside Hukam. Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with.
actionPrompt: Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with. Repeat what you can actually keep.
